criteria.description: Scores each item on all four RICE factors (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort) and computes a score, rather than ranking by gut.
Treats Reach as a real count over a consistent time window (not a 1-10 rating), and uses recognizable Impact/Confidence scales.
Estimates Effort as person-time across functions and uses it as the denominator consistently.
Produces a clear ranked order from the scores.
Adds a sanity-check beyond the raw scores — flags low-confidence/high-score items, or notes strategy/dependencies/sequencing that RICE doesn't capture.
Uses low confidence to recommend validation/testing rather than committing, where relevant (e.g. the unproven mobile-app bet).
